title: On the Complexity of the Compatibility Problem for Succinctly Encoded Conditional Distributions
abstract: arXiv:2608.31120v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The motivation for this paper is the investigation of the trade-offs implicit in probabilistic models used in machine learning. Models are often used to make predictions in the form of conditional probabilities. However, a pair of conditional distributions p(x|y) and p(y|x) may not be compatible with any joint distribution p(x,y). Given two such conditionals, determining if there exists a compatible joint is known as the compatibility problem. For discrete random variables, when the conditionals are encoded as probability tables, the compatibility problem has a known solution, which is computationally tractable. In this paper, we formalise and study a succinct version of the problem, encoding conditional distributions as arithmetic circuits. translated_title: 关于简洁编码条件分布的相容性问题的复杂性研究
translated_abstract: 本文的动机是探究机器学习中概率模型所隐含的权衡问题。模型通常以条件概率的形式进行预测。然而，一对条件分布 p(x|y) 与 p(y|x) 可能与任何联合分布 p(x,y) 都不相容。给定两个这样的条件分布，判断是否存在相容的联合分布的问题被称为相容性问题。对于离散随机变量，当条件分布以概率表的形式编码时，相容性问题已有已知解法，且在计算上是可处理的。在本文中，我们形式化并研究了该问题的简洁版本，即将条件分布编码为算术电路。这适用于高维场景下概率建模的实际应用，包括神经网络模型。我们证明，对于条件分布的简洁电路表示……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文首次形式化了以算术电路简洁编码条件分布的相容性问题，并证明了其计算复杂性，揭示了高维概率建模（如神经网络）中简洁表示与计算可处理性之间的权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes the compatibility problem for conditional distributions succinctly encoded as arithmetic circuits and establishes its computational complexity, revealing the trade-off between succinct representations and tractability in high-dimensional probabilistic modeling such as neural networks.
